title: Adding up thin rings
caption: A ring at distance x from the centre has circumference 2πx, so its area is about 2πx × dx. The graph of 2πx against x is a straight line, and the total area under it from 0 to r = 3 is a triangle of area ½ × 3 × 6π = 9π = πr².
alt: A straight line y = 2πx from 0 to 3 with the triangle under it shaded, labelled with area 9π.
description: A thin ring of radius x and width dx has area about 2πx dx.
Plot the circumference 2πx against x: a straight line through the origin.
Adding the rings from x = 0 to x = r is the area under this line.
For r = 3 the area is 9π = πr².

checks.name: the area under 2πx from 0 to 3 is 9π = π × 3²
